diagnostic: Median/min–max only; trend warnings, no score gate or field INP inference
byteScope: Resources started and completed within fixed first five seconds; source prefetch before activation separate diagnostic; full variable observation retained in gzip
primaryScope: primaryControlProxy is when the journey's primary control was present, not when its content finished
networkScope: Completed CDP requests over the whole observation, prefetch included; a quiet window is geometry only, and rowsWithFinalWindowRequests counts rows still starting requests in the final window
